exercises.instruction: Прочитайте ответы Бена на вопросы. Напишите предложения о Бене, используя often/never и т. д.

items.prompt: Do you ever play tennis? Yes, often.
answers: Ben often plays tennis.

items.prompt: Do you get up early? Yes, always.
answers: He always gets up early.

items.prompt: Are you ever late for work? No, never.
answers: He’s never late for work.
He is never late for work.

items.prompt: Do you ever get angry? Sometimes.
answers: He sometimes gets angry.

items.prompt: Do you ever go swimming? Rarely.
answers: He rarely goes swimming.

items.prompt: Are you at home in the evenings? Yes, usually.
answers: He’s usually at home in the evenings.
He is usually at home in the evenings.

exercises.instruction: Напишите предложения, используя never/always/usually и т. д.

items.prompt: My brother speaks to me. (never)
answers: My brother never speaks to me.

items.prompt: Susan is polite. (always)
answers: Susan is always polite.

items.prompt: I finish work at 5 o’clock. (usually)
answers: I usually finish work at 5 o’clock.

items.prompt: Sarah has started a new job. (just)
answers: Sarah has just started a new job.

items.prompt: I go to bed before midnight. (rarely)
answers: I rarely go to bed before midnight.

items.prompt: The bus isn’t late. (usually)
answers: The bus isn’t usually late.

items.prompt: I don’t eat fish. (often)
answers: I don’t often eat fish.

items.prompt: I will forget what you said. (never)
answers: I will never forget what you said.

items.prompt: Have you lost your passport? (ever)
answers: Have you ever lost your passport?

items.prompt: Do you work in the same place? (still)
answers: Do you still work in the same place?

items.prompt: They stay in the same hotel. (always)
answers: They always stay in the same hotel.

items.prompt: Jane doesn’t work on Saturdays. (usually)
answers: Jane doesn’t usually work on Saturdays.

items.prompt: Is Tina here? (already)
answers: Is Tina already here?

items.prompt: What do you have for breakfast? (usually)
answers: What do you usually have for breakfast?

items.prompt: I can remember his name. (never)
answers: I can never remember his name.

items.prompt: Do you play football? (tennis)
answers: Yes, and I also play tennis.

items.prompt: Do you speak Italian? (French)
answers: Yes, and I also speak French.

items.prompt: Are you tired? (hungry)
answers: Yes, and I’m also hungry.

items.prompt: Have you been to England? (Ireland)
answers: Yes, and I’ve also been to Ireland.

items.prompt: Did you buy any clothes? (some books)
answers: Yes, and I also bought some books.

exercises.instruction: Напишите предложения, используя both и all.

items.prompt: I live in London. I play football. I’m a student. I’ve got a car.
answers: They both live in London.
They both play football.
They’re both students.
They are both students.
They’ve both got cars.
They both have cars.

items.prompt: I’m married. I was born in England. I live in New York.
answers: They’re all married.
They are all married.
They were all born in England.
They all live in New York.

exercises.instruction: Переведите предложения на английский язык. [(2) на работу = for work; за границу = abroad; ездить на велосипеде = cycle]

items.prompt: Я редко хожу в театр.
answers: I rarely go to the theatre.
I seldom go to the theatre.

items.prompt: Бен часто опаздывает на работу.
answers: Ben is often late for work.

items.prompt: Вы когда-нибудь ездили за границу?
answers: Have you ever travelled abroad?
Have you ever been abroad?

items.prompt: Я никогда не забуду наш отпуск в Берлине.
answers: I will never forget our holiday in Berlin.

items.prompt: Обычно мы не встаём рано.
answers: We don’t usually get up early.

items.prompt: Джесс здесь нет. Она только что ушла в супермаркет.
answers: Jess isn’t here. She’s just gone to the supermarket.

items.prompt: Иногда я езжу на работу на велосипеде.
answers: I sometimes cycle to work.
Sometimes I cycle to work.

items.prompt: У меня есть две сестры. Они обе живут в России.
answers: I have two sisters. They both live in Russia.
I’ve got two sisters. They both live in Russia.
